scope: CellSim herbivore Stat-Line metrics emitted in run and phase experiment reports.

statusSemantics.Valid: The value was calculated from a valid denominator and may be used in analysis.
statusSemantics.N/A: The event needed for the denominator did not occur in this window. The stored numeric value is a placeholder and must not be treated as a measured zero.
statusSemantics.INVALID: The recorded counts do not satisfy the metric contract. Do not use the value in analysis.

windowSemantics.run: The complete simulation run, from its first population snapshot through its final population snapshot.
windowSemantics.phase: One continued-run phase. Opening population is measured at the phase boundary; closing population and events cover only that phase.

metrics.name: Starting population
metrics.definition: Number of the scored herbivore species alive at the start of the measurement window.
metrics.direction: Higher means the window began with more herbivores; there is no universal better direction.

metrics.name: Predator-active herbivore steps
metrics.definition: Sum of living herbivores on simulation steps where at least one carnivore was alive.
metrics.direction: Higher means more total herbivore exposure time while predators existed; it is an exposure denominator, not a quality score.

metrics.name: Encountered herbivore steps
metrics.definition: Sum of living herbivores for steps in which that herbivore species had at least one recorded carnivore encounter.
metrics.direction: Higher means predator encounters affected a larger share of exposure time; lower normally indicates better avoidance when HPS is comparable.

metrics.name: Predator encounters
metrics.definition: Number of recorded carnivore-to-herbivore attack opportunities after pre-contact avoidance.
metrics.direction: Higher means more predator contact; lower normally indicates better avoidance when opportunity conditions are comparable.

metrics.name: Predation deaths
metrics.definition: Herbivores killed by carnivores. This does not count food resources consumed or every combat death.
metrics.direction: Higher means more herbivores were killed by predators; lower is normally better for herbivore survival.

metrics.name: Starvation deaths
metrics.definition: Herbivore death events whose proximate cause is starvation.
metrics.direction: Higher means more starvation loss; lower is normally better.

metrics.name: Mating candidates
metrics.definition: Reproduction candidate evaluations for the herbivore species, including candidates later blocked or failed.
metrics.direction: Higher means more reproduction opportunities were evaluated; it is a denominator, not automatically a better outcome.

metrics.name: Births
metrics.definition: Herbivore offspring successfully placed during the measurement window.
metrics.direction: Higher means more successful births; whether that is better depends on survival and crowding costs.

metrics.name: Crowding deaths
metrics.definition: Herbivore death events whose proximate cause is crowding.
metrics.direction: Higher means more crowding loss; lower is normally better.

metrics.name: Final population
metrics.definition: Number of the scored herbivore species alive at the end of the measurement window.
metrics.direction: Higher means the window ended with more herbivores; there is no universal better direction without a target population band.

metrics.name: Expected final population
metrics.definition: Population implied by the Stat-Line accounting identity: SPO + BIR - PREY - STRV - CRWD.
metrics.direction: This is an accounting check. Direction is not scored; it should equal FPO.

metrics.name: Population reconciled
metrics.definition: True when FPO equals SPO + BIR - PREY - STRV - CRWD for the same window.
metrics.direction: True is required for trusted composite scores; false means the Stat-Line is inconsistent.

metrics.name: Inverse prey average
metrics.definition: Share of predator encounters that did not end in a predation death: 1 - PREY / ECN.
metrics.direction: Higher means better survival after contact. Read pAVIStatus before using the numeric value.

metrics.name: Inverse encounter average
metrics.definition: Share of predator-active herbivore exposure that did not occur on an encounter step: 1 - EHS / HPS.
metrics.direction: Higher means better avoidance before contact. Read eAVIStatus before using the numeric value.

metrics.name: Predation average
metrics.definition: Mean of the applicable pAVI and eAVI values; if only one is applicable, that value is used.
metrics.direction: Higher means better combined avoidance and post-contact survival. Read predAVGStatus before using the numeric value.

metrics.name: Inverse starvation average
metrics.definition: Share of the population available before starvation that did not starve: 1 - STRV / (SPO + BIR - PREY).
metrics.direction: Higher means better survival against starvation. Read sAVIStatus before using the numeric value.

metrics.name: Inverse crowding average
metrics.definition: Share of the population available before crowding that did not die from crowding: 1 - CRWD / (SPO + BIR - PREY - STRV).
metrics.direction: Higher means better survival against crowding. Read cAVIStatus before using the numeric value.

metrics.name: Birth average
metrics.definition: Successful births per reproduction candidate evaluation: BIR / MAT.
metrics.direction: Higher means more candidate evaluations produced births; its gameplay value still depends on later survival and crowding. Read bAVGStatus before use.

metrics.name: Replication fitness score
metrics.definition: Net population change weighted by birth conversion: (FPO - SPO) * bAVG.
metrics.direction: Higher means stronger population growth combined with effective reproduction; negative values mean decline. Read RFSStatus before use.

metrics.name: Actual prey score
metrics.definition: Composite herbivore outcome: applicable RFS + predAVG - (1 - sAVI) - (1 - cAVI).
metrics.direction: Higher means a better combined replication, predation, starvation, and crowding outcome under this formula. Read APSStatus and reconciliation before use.
